Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misattributed the creation of Michael Corleone to Francis Ford Coppola and presented a fabricated “exact sentence” supposedly from Britannica. This conflated the film adaptation role (Coppola) with the original character creation (Mario Puzo) and included a factual inaccuracy (claiming Coppola was a WWII veteran). This erroneous extraction directly led toward a wrong solution.
